kind: rig: the real local Gatekeeper, agentgateway 1.7.0 as a local binary, gateway-authz and provider-signer as local processes
operator_and_approver: Not recorded. The repository owner decided on 2026-11-19 (development plan 1.6) that this technical software has no operator and approver kept apart: this file records what was run, on which commits and images, and what was seen.
